$comment: Allow-list for the dark-mode axe pass in e2e/a11y-dark.spec.ts.
Same ratchet contract as a11y-baseline.json: every entry names one axe rule,
the pass ('dark') and the fixture-section slugs it applies to, plus a
node-level predicate (contrast or htmlIncludes). A violation is suppressed
only when EVERY one of its nodes matches an exception; an exception with no
predicate is rejected at load time.
This gate scans the LIBRARY fixture (test-fixtures/primitives, Rooms skin
removed) in dark mode. After W1 (text-on-primary + warning made mode-aware)
the library clears AA in dark mode. The gate is a
regression guard, not a deferral ledger. Add an entry only for a deliberate,
Scope: the 13 static fixture primitives in their default states — no open
overlays, focus/hover states, or Menu/Tooltip surfaces. A dark-only bug in an
overlay, focus ring, or the Rooms-skin dark primary-as-foreground (see
technical-debt) is out of this gate's reach; style/contrast.test.ts guards the
token math for every intent x mode statically.
